Random-effects design for a pass (single or MET random intercepts)

Source: R/pass.R
dot-pass_re_design.Rd

Returns the per-observation group index/indices and group counts for the grouping factor(s) of the random intercept(s). NULL for a population pass. Used by the RE lenses (the marginal likelihood) and the integrated predictive.

Usage

.pass_re_design(pass)

Arguments

pass

A koine_pass.

Value

A list as described above, or NULL when the pass has no random effect.

Details

For the single random-intercept case the returned list carries the legacy fields grouping, group, levels, and n_groups directly (so the existing single-RE code path is byte-identical). It always also carries factors, a per-grouping list of list(grouping, group, levels, n_groups), the structure ("single" / "crossed" / "nested"), and the grouping names — the surface the MET marginal core reads.
